x: The 44th Amendment Act is 'of 1978', but it got assent on 30 April 1979 and the omission of Art. 31 took effect on 20 June 1979, so property ceased to be an FR from 1979 (printed key: 1978).
source: constitutionofindia.net Art. 31 (omitted by 44th Amendment s.6, w.e.f. 20-6-1979)
dispute: Most books and exam keys give 1978, the year of the 44th Amendment Act. Strictly, Article 31 was deleted with effect from 20 June 1979, when that part of the Act came into force.
